_comment: Updated 2026-07-21 (F1284). hash() HARD = 0: 20 REPRESENTATION sites -> hdc.klein4_encode_bytes, 5 ROUTING/DIGEST sites -> format.sha256_bytes. The two jobs need DIFFERENT ops (F1277); a routing-first pass silently converts representation seeds to sha256 ('stable but not resonant'), so representation must be matched FIRST. abs(): 71 tolerance COMPARISONS were reverted from cascade.magnitude back to abs() and marked srmech-allow, because magnitude has a documented Class-K DEAD-BAND (NaN -> 0.0) that in a threshold turns a NaN failure into a PASS. srmech's own package and C source contain ZERO abs() calls, while its TEST SUITE uses abs() at 649 sites for exactly this reason -- upstream is compliant and the distinction is real: Class-K magnitude COMPUTES a magnitude, it does not GUARD a threshold.
